subject: FleetPay outage accounting and remedy request
messages:
From: Anna Lopez <anna@fleetpay.com>
To: david.kim@redwood.com
Date: 2029-03-01T01:15:00Z
Subject: Payment API outage — confirmation and remedial request

David —

We saw a significant outage on FleetPay's integration with Redwood between 2029-02-28 23:45 UTC and 2029-03-01 01:10 UTC: our ingestion layer recorded ~15% requests returning 503 and median latency spiking from 180ms to ~2.3s. This impacted our settlement flow for ~700 transactions.

We've attached a small bundle with request ids and sample client-side traces (attachment: fleetpay-error-log-2029-02-28.zip). We need Redwood to: 
- Confirm the exact outage windows you observe on your side (UTC)
- State whether this qualifies for SLA credit under our contract
- Share a timeline for a post-incident report and any immediate mitigations

FleetPay is evaluating renewal terms this quarter; an expedited confirmation would be appreciated.

Thanks,
Anna Lopez
Sr. Payments Ops — FleetPay
anna@fleetpay.com

Attachments: fleetpay-error-log-2029-02-28.zip
From: david.kim@redwood.com <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: Anna Lopez <anna@fleetpay.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2029-03-01T02:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Payment API outage — confirmation and remedial request

Anna —

Thanks for the report and the bundle. I'm escalating this to SRE and our SLA adjudication team (cc'd). Quick confirmations: can you share a concise list of the FleetPay request IDs for the highest-impact failures (a short text file is fine)? That will speed correlation on our side.

Immediate next steps from Redwood:
- SRE will run an initial correlation against our telemetry and return a suspected impact window within 24–48 hours.
- If we confirm an SLA-eligible outage, we will open a formal adjudication ticket and calculate a pro-rata credit.
- We will aim to deliver an initial post-incident brief within 72 hours and a fuller RCA within 10 business days.

I'll follow up with the SRE findings and the adjudication ticket id.

Best,
David Kim
Account Executive — Redwood Inference

On Fri, Mar 1, 2029 at 01:15 AM Anna Lopez <anna@fleetpay.com> wrote:
> David —
> 
> We saw a significant outage ... (see attachment)
From: laura_bennett@redwood.com <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: david.kim@redwood.com, Anna Lopez <anna@fleetpay.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2029-03-02T08:21:00Z
Subject: Re: Payment API outage — confirmation and remedial request

Hi Anna / David —

Initial SRE read: we observed a pronounced spike in 5xx responses originating in the us-west-2 serving cluster starting 2029-02-28T23:47:12Z and tapering off around 2029-03-01T00:58:39Z (UTC). During that window our 5xx rate aggregated to ~12.7% for FleetPay's tenancy. Root cause is not yet fully established; preliminary traces show a burst of auth gateway 502/timeout behaviour upstream of the inference pool which led to increased queueing and some request drops when the autoscaler hit a short cold-path in a subset of pods.

I've attached two small artifacts that may help with correlation: region-trace-snippet-uw2.txt (sample spans) and svc-telemetry-summary.csv (aggregate counters for the 90-minute window). Please send the FleetPay request ids you have so we can do direct trace joins.

We will:
- Open internal incident SLA-2029-031 for adjudication and evidence collection (JIRA: JIRA-RED-2348)
- Provide a preliminary impact window confirmation within 24 hours of receiving request ids
- Produce a post-incident summary (initial) within 72 hours; full RCA by 10 BD

Laura Bennett
SRE Manager, Redwood Inference

Attachments: region-trace-snippet-uw2.txt, svc-telemetry-summary.csv
From: Anna Lopez <anna@fleetpay.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, david.kim@redwood.com
Date: 2029-03-03T12:10:00Z
Subject: Re: Payment API outage — confirmation and remedial request

Laura —

Thanks for the quick look. I've exported the highest-impact request ids per your ask and attached them (fleetpay-request-ids.txt). The client-side timestamps line up with your window.

A few clarifying points:
- We routed traffic via two different API keys during the window; please make sure both keys are considered when you compute per-tenant impact.
- We're particularly interested in the prorated credit estimate and whether Redwood will offer a one-time operational credit to cover transaction fees lost.

Please escalate to billing/adjudication as needed — we need a clear number to present internally.

Anna

Attachment: fleetpay-request-ids.txt
From: david.kim@redwood.com <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: Anna Lopez <anna@fleetpay.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2029-03-04T09:34:00Z
Subject: Re: Payment API outage — confirmation and remedial request

Anna —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the request ids. Internal update: we've formally opened SLA adjudication ticket SLA-2029-031 (JIRA-RED-2348) and assigned a billing reviewer. Preliminary confirmation from SRE matches your time window and shows ~12.7% error rate for FleetPay's tenancy in us-west-2. Karthik will run the prorata credit calc against your committed monthly usage and provide an estimate tomorrow (EOD PST).

Proposed remedial steps for your approval: 
1) Redwood will produce a preliminary post-incident brief by 2029-03-05T17:00:00Z UTC.
2) If SLA eligibility is confirmed, Redwood will apply a pro-rata usage credit and offer a one-time operational credit as a gesture for settlement fee exposure (amount to be proposed by Karthik).
3) Full RCA delivery by 2029-03-15 (business-day timeline).

Please reply to confirm acceptance of the timeline; if FleetPay needs a faster cadence we can prioritize the brief.

Best,
David

On Sat, Mar 2, 2029 at 08:21 AM laura_bennett@redwood.com wrote:

> 
> Initial SRE read: ...
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Anna Lopez <anna@fleetpay.com>, david.kim@redwood.com
Date: 2029-03-05T17:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Payment API outage — confirmation and remedial request

Anna —

Quick update on the credit estimate: based on FleetPay's committed monthly tokens and the 12.7% error window for ~1.4 hours, preliminary pro-rata usage credit estimate is ~6.3% of the affected day's usage (billing calc in progress). We're also modelling a modest one-time operational credit to offset payment-provider fees; I should have a recommended credit amount and a draft credit note to share by 2029-03-06T16:00:00Z PST.

If that's acceptable I'll put the calc into a formal credit note and route to finance for approval.

Karthik Iyer
Head of Revenue Operations — Redwood Inference
